integrity: The universal claim is proved analytically from an exact Lyapunov identity, positive invariance, compactness, LaSalle invariance, uniqueness, and monotonicity. The bundled exact-rational computation checks representative algebraic identities but is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The global theorem identifies the only two possible forward limits at the critical equality, but it does not give the full basin of the nonzero limit state outside the invariant plane \(v=0\). The sharp \(1/t\) law is proved only on that invariant plane for \(u(0)>b\).
title: The critical Allee–carrying coincidence has two global limit states
